description: Linear classifier that models class probabilities via the softmax function. Regularized with L2 penalty; C controls inverse regularization strength; class weighting addresses imbalance.
why_tested: Baseline linear method covered at mid-semester; well-calibrated linear reference that is fast to train and predict.
input_features: Sparse word unigram/bigram TF-IDF (max_features=60000, min_df=2, max_df=0.99, sublinear_tf=True). Negation tokens such as 'not' and 'without' are kept as ordinary tokens.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/logistic_regression/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + vectorizer.joblib + metadata.json).
